The LORD reigns; let the nations tremble! He is enthroned above the cherubim; let the earth quake!
The Lord is King; let the peoples be in fear: his seat is on the winged ones; let the earth be moved.
耶和華作王；萬民當戰抖！他坐在二基路伯上，地當動搖。
Great is the LORD in Zion; He is exalted above all the peoples.
The Lord is great in Zion; he is high over all the nations.
耶和華在錫安為大；他超乎萬民之上。
Let them praise Your great and awesome name— He is holy!
Let them give praise to your name, for it is great and to be feared; holy is he.
他們當稱讚他大而可畏的名；他本為聖！
The mighty King loves justice. You have established equity; You have exercised justice and righteousness in Jacob.
The king's power is used for righteousness; you give true decisions, judging rightly in the land of Jacob.
王有能力，喜愛公平，堅立公正，在雅各中施行公平和公義。
Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at His footstool; He is holy!
Give high honour to the Lord our God, worshipping at his feet; holy is he.
你們當尊崇耶和華─我們的神，在他腳凳前下拜。他本為聖！
Moses and Aaron were among His priests; Samuel was among those who called on His name. They called to the LORD and He answered.
Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among those who gave honour to his name; they made prayers to the Lord, and he gave answers to them.
在他的祭司中有摩西和亞倫；在求告他名的人中有撒母耳。他們求告耶和華，他就應允他們。
He spoke to them from the pillar of cloud; they kept His decrees and the statutes He gave them.
His voice came to them from the pillar of cloud; they kept his witness, and the law which he gave them.
他在雲柱中對他們說話；他們遵守他的法度和他所賜給他們的律例。
O LORD our God, You answered them. You were a forgiving God to them, yet an avenger of their misdeeds.
You gave them an answer, O Lord our God; you took away their sin, though you gave them punishment for their wrongdoing.
耶和華─我們的神啊，你應允他們；你是赦免他們的神，卻按他們所行的報應他們。
Exalt the LORD our God and worship at His holy mountain, for the LORD our God is holy.
Give high honour to the Lord our God, worshipping with your faces turned to his holy hill; for the Lord our God is holy.
你們要尊崇耶和華─我們的神，在他的聖山下拜，因為耶和華─我們的神本為聖！
